content.json:
# Threat and Exposure Management

Consolidated risk across MDE vulnerabilities, MDE recommendations, Rapid7 web application findings, and Defender for Cloud recommendations. The workbook expects the `TEM_NormalizedFindings()` function to exist in the selected Log Analytics workspace.

content.query:
TEM_NormalizedFindings()
| where RiskScore >= todouble('{MinimumRisk}')
| summarize Findings=count(), Assets=dcount(AssetId), CriticalRisk=countif(RiskScore >= 90), HighRisk=countif(RiskScore between (70.0 .. 89.9)), MaxRisk=max(RiskScore)
| extend MaxRisk=round(MaxRisk, 1)
content.title: TEM summary

content.query:
TEM_NormalizedFindings()
| where RiskScore >= todouble('{MinimumRisk}')
| summarize Findings=count(), Assets=dcount(AssetId), AverageRisk=round(avg(RiskScore), 1), MaxRisk=max(RiskScore) by SourceSystem, FindingType
| order by MaxRisk desc
content.title: Risk by source and finding type

content.query:
TEM_NormalizedFindings()
| where RiskScore >= todouble('{MinimumRisk}')
| summarize Findings=count(), Assets=dcount(AssetId), MaxRisk=max(RiskScore) by AssetCriticality, AssetExposure, FindingSeverity
| order by MaxRisk desc, Findings desc
content.title: Risk matrix: asset criticality, exposure, and finding severity

content.query:
TEM_NormalizedFindings()
| where RiskScore >= todouble('{MinimumRisk}')
| summarize Findings=count(), MaxRisk=max(RiskScore), Sources=make_set(SourceSystem, 10), FindingTypes=make_set(FindingType, 10) by AssetId, AssetName, AssetKind, AssetCriticality, AssetExposure, BusinessService, Owner
| top 50 by MaxRisk desc
| project MaxRisk, Findings, AssetName, AssetKind, AssetCriticality, AssetExposure, BusinessService, Owner, Sources, FindingTypes, AssetId
content.title: Highest-risk assets

content.query:
TEM_NormalizedFindings()
| where RiskScore >= todouble('{MinimumRisk}')
| top 100 by RiskScore desc
| project RiskScore, SourceSystem, FindingType, AssetName, AssetKind, AssetCriticality, AssetExposure, FindingSeverity, FindingId, FindingTitle, Status, Remediation, LastSeen
content.title: Top findings on assets

content.query:
TEM_NormalizedFindings()
| summarize Rows=count(), MissingAssetCriticality=countif(isempty(AssetCriticality)), MissingAssetExposure=countif(isempty(AssetExposure)), MissingFindingSeverity=countif(isempty(FindingSeverity) or FindingSeverity == 'Unknown'), MissingRiskScore=countif(isnull(RiskScore)), MissingRemediation=countif(isempty(Remediation)) by SourceSystem, FindingType
| extend AssetCriticalityCoverage=round(100.0 * (Rows - MissingAssetCriticality) / Rows, 1), AssetExposureCoverage=round(100.0 * (Rows - MissingAssetExposure) / Rows, 1), SeverityCoverage=round(100.0 * (Rows - MissingFindingSeverity) / Rows, 1), RiskScoreCoverage=round(100.0 * (Rows - MissingRiskScore) / Rows, 1), RemediationCoverage=round(100.0 * (Rows - MissingRemediation) / Rows, 1)
| project SourceSystem, FindingType, Rows, AssetCriticalityCoverage, AssetExposureCoverage, SeverityCoverage, RiskScoreCoverage, RemediationCoverage
| order by SourceSystem asc, FindingType asc
content.title: Normalized field coverage
